# Vpack Machine Pvt. Ltd.

> Vpack Machine Pvt. Ltd. is a New Delhi based manufacturer and supplier of turnkey mineral water plants, packaged drinking water and water bottling plants, soda and soft drink plants, fruit juice processing plants, liquid filling plants, PET blow moulding machines and related machinery for the water, beverage and pharma sectors.

Contact: suman@vermaprocesspack.com · +91 9135636541 · +91 8448868851
Address: Plot No- 154/184, Balmiki Chaupal, Near Chota MCD School, Pooth Khurd, New Delhi 110039, India
